therapeutic_hypothesis.claimed_target: amyloid-beta and other pathological antibody targets
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Adults with amnestic mild cognitive impairment (a-MCI)
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Annualized Percent Change in Ventricular Volume (APCV) as measured by MRI at baseline, 12, and 24 months

results.effect_size: APCV 0-12 months: IVIG 5.87% vs placebo 8.14%; APCV 0-24 months: IVIG 6.26% vs placebo 7.08% (percent change per participant year)
results.target_engagement_evidence: CSF Aβ1-42/P-Tau181P Alzheimer signature subgroup assessed; ventricular volumes reported by CSF biomarker status
biomarker_changes: Mean ventricular volume at 24 months in Aβ42 subgroup: IVIG 294.00 cc vs placebo 353.41 cc
Mean ventricular volume at 24 months in tau subgroup: IVIG 107.47 cc vs placebo 96.18 cc
Mean ventricular volume at 24 months in p-tau subgroup: IVIG 43.59 cc vs placebo 39.47 cc
subgroup_findings: APCV baseline to 12 months: IVIG 5.87 vs placebo 8.14 (percent/year)
APCV baseline to 24 months: IVIG 6.26 vs placebo 7.08 (percent/year)
Conversion from a-MCI to AD at 24 months: IVIG 16 participants vs placebo 10 participants
MMSE at 12 months: IVIG 26.04 vs placebo 25.38
ADAS-Cog at 12 months: IVIG 11.03 vs placebo 11.00
CDR-SB at 12 months: IVIG 2.7 vs placebo 2.65
MMSE at 24 months: IVIG 24.00 vs placebo 24.46
ADAS-Cog at 24 months: IVIG 15.39 vs placebo 13.25
CDR-SB at 24 months: IVIG 4.33 vs placebo 3.37
More IVIG-treated participants converted to AD (16 vs 10) suggesting no benefit on conversion

subgroups.raw_descriptor: Clinical Dementia Rating Sum of Boxes (CDR-SB)
